claim_blocks.paragraph: The public economic pulse is warming_up and fails its substantive-desk gate at 3 of 5 and its baseline-history gate at 1 of 8 months. The primary-document index retains 13 document records, but 13 are marked not_parsed, so capture receipts cannot substitute for normalized economic observations. The machine desk therefore abstains from a broad direction-of-economy synthesis until the declared coverage, history and parsing gates pass.

countercases.disposition: Retained; partial coverage does not cure failed desk breadth and historical-baseline gates.
countercases.statement: Several live series and independent source groups already exist in the economic pulse.

countercases.disposition: Rejected as a publication basis because capture state and parsed observation state are distinct.
countercases.statement: A substantial primary-document archive can look like sufficient evidence by volume alone.

dek: The machine desk tests primary-document parsing, historical depth and cross-desk coverage, then either publishes a bounded readiness analysis or records why it abstained.

gates.detail: Three of three abstention-explanation sentences have non-empty citations.

evidence.interpretation_limit: A readiness receipt evaluates whether a synthesis can publish; it is not itself an economic observation.
evidence.title: Economic pulse publication gates

evidence.interpretation_limit: The index records retrieval metadata for 14 registered sources; captured documents marked not_parsed do not provide normalized observations for synthesis.
evidence.title: Primary-document capture and parsing coverage

falsifiers.statement: The abstention should be retired when the same deterministic build observes every predeclared readiness gate passing.
falsifiers.test: Rebuild after normalized observations provide at least five substantive desks and eight qualifying baseline months, then re-evaluate all gates.

hypotheses.statement: The predeclared public-evidence gates support beginning a bounded synthesis of China's economic direction.

limitations.consequence: Historical context remains bounded to the retained qualifying monthly observations.
limitations.statement: The divergence baseline contains 1 qualifying months against a minimum of 8.

limitations.consequence: Any later synthesis must preserve desk-specific coverage rather than treating the composite as uniformly observed.
limitations.statement: Current substantive-desk coverage is 3 against a minimum of 5.

limitations.consequence: The desk may cite capture coverage but may not infer values from any unparsed record.
limitations.statement: The primary-document index currently contains 13 records marked not_parsed.

methodology.description: Hash the exact four public input files and validate their declared schemas.
Read, without overriding, the economic pulse's predeclared readiness receipt.
Keep primary-document capture receipts separate from normalized economic observations.
Emit an AbstentionReport whenever any substantive publication gate fails.

prohibited_interpretations: Do not treat aggregate measurements as claims about identifiable people.
Do not infer intent, motive, or responsibility from technical correlation.
Do not describe this output as human reporting or a human interview.

status_reason: Abstained because these predeclared evidence-readiness gates failed: substantive-desks, baseline-months, and parsed-primary-observations.
title: Is Palimpsest ready to describe China's economic direction?
